body: Interactive agent benchmarks and multi-turn reinforcement learning increasingly place a second language model in the role of the user. This simulated user controls what information the agent receives and when, yet current benchmarks score only the agent and do not directly measure whether the user correctly executed its assigned role. We introduce UserProxyBench, an evaluation layer over the tau-bench family, and the User Fidelity Score (UFS), which measures adherence to the benchmark's private user instructions using task-grounded rubric criteria scored independently of agent success. Holding the agent fixed at GPT-5.5 and varying only the user proxy across 375 enterprise tasks changes mean task reward by 15.2 points, while 24.4% of successful episodes contain a user-specification violation. The dominant failure is premature disclosure: users provide information before it is requested. This behavior has little effect on task reward, yet among successful episodes it causes the agent to make 1.06 fewer tool calls on average, changing the interaction being evaluated while preserving the reward. Finally, across seven proxies we identify an empirical cost-fidelity frontier, enabling practitioners to select the least expensive simulator that satisfies a required fidelity level.
summaryZh: 本文针对交互式智能体基准测试中“用户模拟器”评估缺失的问题，提出了UserProxyBench及用户忠实度评分（UFS）。研究发现，用户模拟器的行为差异会显著影响智能体的任务表现和工具调用模式，且存在“过早披露信息”等常见失败模式。该基准测试通过引入任务接地准则，实现了对用户模拟器执行角色忠实度的独立评估，为构建更可靠的智能体训练环境提供了量化工具。

glossary.explanationZh: 用户模拟器，在智能体基准测试中扮演用户角色，与智能体进行交互。
用户忠实度评分，衡量模拟用户是否严格遵循基准测试设定的指令。
一个用于评估智能体在企业级任务中表现的基准测试家族。
任务接地准则，用于评估交互过程中用户行为是否符合特定任务要求的评分标准。
